name: learnhub
description: LearnHub monorepo: Next.js web app + Express API

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web exec tsc -- --noEmit
